info.submission: RestAPI fully implemented in rest_api.py: GET /users (all users, or filtered subset sorted by name), POST /add (creates user, returns User object), POST /iou (bilateral netting of existing debt, clears reciprocal entries, returns both users sorted by name, balance = owed_by - owes). Public suite passed 9/9 (candidate-001, digest 7b154eaa...); custom edge-case reproducer also verified accumulation, both-direction netting, exact payoff, and sorted filtering.
